title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 49 (Labor Regulations), Chapter 49.48 - Wages - Payment - Collection
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=49.48 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 49 / Chapter 49.48', heading 'Chapter 49.48 RCW - WAGES - PAYMENT - COLLECTION', section list beginning RCW 49.48.010 (Payment of wages/nonsufficient funds - Employer must reimburse employee for fees charged - Payment of wages due to employee ceasing work to be at end of pay period - Authorized deductions or withholdings), 49.48.020 (Penalty for noncompliance), 49.48.030 (Attorney's fee in action on wages), 49.48.040 (Enforcement of wage claims), 49.48.060, 49.48.070, 49.48.075, 49.48.082 and 49.48.083, with 'Complete chapter' HTML and PDF links and an 'RCW dispositions' link. Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: RCW 49.48.083 (wage complaints - duty of department to investigate) is printed THREE times on the register, '(as amended by 2026 c 53)', '(as amended by 2026 c 77)' and '(as amended by 2026 c 176)' - three 2026 Acts amended the same section and the Code Reviser has not yet merged them. Anyone encoding this section must reconcile the three versions. The Minimum Wage Act is the separate chapter 49.46 RCW.
